label: basal
note: at the base of the plant or axis

label: upper
note: nearer the apex than the others of its kind

label: lower
note: nearer the base than the others of its kind

label: inner
note: nearer the centre or axis than the others of its kind

label: outer
note: farther from the centre or axis than the others of its kind

label: lateral
note: at the side, not terminal or median

label: median
note: in the middle of a series

label: terminal
note: at the end of the axis or series
